title: Operand evaluation under list extension
statement: Let $x:	ext{Fin}(n)	o	ext{Bool}$ be an assignment, let $o$ be an operand, and let $ys$ and $ext$ be Boolean lists. If every line operand referenced by $o$ has index less than the length of $ys$ (with input and negated-input operands satisfying this condition automatically), then evaluating $o$ on $ys$ appended with $ext$ gives the same value as evaluating it on $ys$.
hypotheses_covered: The condition that any referenced line index is less than $|ys|$
